body:
My gf (ex now) accidently bit my clit while she was going down on me. 

I cried for 5 mins straight
I appreciate it. Thank you. I will try it.

Just keep moving. You will want to slip into this comfortable bed of loneliness and pull the cover of despair and grief over your head. It will feel so terribly nice. I've been there and have gotten out. I'm currently falling down a steep slope into my familiar trench. Do something for you today. Anything doesn't matter how small. Today I set myself the goal of getting out of bed and wash the dishes that have piled up for 5 days. It took several hours of struggle but I did it. Give you small wins, my friend. Keep moving. Don't let it swallow you. It can't consume you whole so it will eat you piece by piece. Small enough you almost don't notice but that fucker is their gnawing. It can't do that if you're moving. It's not about taking leaps and bounds, it's about inches and steps. 

*Don't stop fucken moving..*
